summary: Implemented archived-author recovery in draft PR #78. Explicit Return to Build/Start task restores only the original idle Build session in its same ready managed worktree, revalidating identity/readiness before durable dispatch. Polling preserves completed results without reopening archived threads. Restoration failures preserve actionable Review; deleted/moved/busy/unavailable sessions, stale approval, repair limits and uncertain sends remain guarded. Added regression cases, README and complete decisions D-009/D-008. Committed authorized existing journal edits. Synced current origin/main without conflicts. Local tests/browser checks are unrun under on-demand iteration policy; implementation only, no verification/integration claimed.

state.request: Fix the Taskboard automatic-start behavior that pauses work when a build reports recoverable blockers like the supplied Roten-App result. Improve automatic work startup so blocker summaries are handled accurately and the task does not stop prematurely when actionable implementation work can continue, while preserving genuine human-decision, tracker, evidence, and policy gates.
